facts.fact: The national cybersecurity strategy (SNCS) 2021-2025 is stated adopted in December 2021, per ANSSI's director general; the 2026-2030 text is only a draft.
ANSSI, headed by a director general, is stated to be evaluating the 2021-2025 strategy and preparing the 2026-2030 one at a workshop on 2026-07-23.
